h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dhule

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dhule

items.pText: At about 260 km from our Vasai factory, Dhule is one of the closer district towns we supply in Maharashtra. The equipment travels by road through north Maharashtra, and our installation team or a local dealer sets it up on site. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured playground equipment since 2002 for schools, housing societies and municipal gardens.

Khandesh summers are long and very hot, and the monsoon here is shorter than on the coast. Equipment in Dhule has to cope with months of dry heat. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic suit these conditions, and both carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Our design team also builds Funplay Originals, play structures inspired by Indian games, which give a school something different from the usual slide and swing.

richText.heading: Planning for mixed age groups in a Dhule school

c: A school ground in Dhule often serves children from nursery to class eight on the same equipment, and that rarely works well. Younger children need low slides, spring riders and small climbers, while older ones want height, nets and balance pieces. We suggest two separate zones with a clear walkway between them, so a group of older children does not run through the nursery area.

items.q: How do you separate equipment for small and older children?
items.a: We mark two zones on the layout drawing, each with its own safe play area. Low pieces go in the junior zone and taller structures in the senior zone, with a walkway in between.

items.q: Who installs playground equipment in Dhule?
items.a: The equipment goes by road from Vasai, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground.

items.q: Can the colours match our school's branding?
items.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your school colours and we will suggest a combination that works outdoors.
